Arithmetic: Vulgar fractions and decimals, H.C.F. and L.C.M., simple and compound interest, simple and compound practice, percentage, profit and loss, mixtures, partnership, averages, rates and taxes, insurance, square and cubic measures, and problems on time-and-work and time-and-distance. Submit a separate application for each post, clearly mentioning the post name in capital letters (underlined) on top of the application form and envelope.
Send the application by Speed Post to: Registrar, Civil Courts, Bhadrak, At- Nalanga, P.O- Barikpur Bazar, Dist- Bhadrak, Pin-756112, so as to reach by 5:00 P.M. on or before 28.08.2026.
Alternatively, drop the application in the "Application Drop Box" kept in the office of the Registrar, Civil Courts, Bhadrak, during office hours on working days.

content_sections.heading: Bhadrak District Court Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must be citizens of India and satisfy the educational, age, and physical eligibility conditions given below for the post they wish to apply for. Passed at least a +3 Examination (or an equivalent qualification) from a recognized university. Passed at least a Diploma in Computer Application from a recognized institute. Able to speak, read, and write Odia, and passed a test in Odia equivalent to the M.E. Standard. For Junior Typist: minimum typing speed of 40 words per minute in English Type Writing. For Stenographer Grade-III: minimum speed of 80 words per minute in shorthand and 40 words per minute in English Type Writing. Passed the matriculation examination or an equivalent examination from a recognized Board. Passed the Revenue Inspector Training from a Government/recognized institution. Possess knowledge in computer. Must be of good character and sound health, with good physique and free from organic defect or communicable disease. Must not have more than one spouse living, if married. Must have registered his/her name in an Employment Exchange. No criminal proceeding should be pending against the candidate. Candidates already working under the State or Central Government must inform their Head of Office and obtain a "No Objection Certificate" before applying.

content_sections.heading: Bhadrak District Court Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection for each post is made through a Written Examination, a Skill/Computer Science Test, and a Viva-Voce Test. The written examination for all posts will be conducted on the same day. Candidates securing at least 35% marks in each written paper will be called for the Computer Science Test, up to ten times the vacancy in each category. The qualifying cut-off in the Computer Science Test is 50% for General/other category candidates and 40% for SC/ST candidates. Candidates securing a minimum of 55% marks (50% for SC/ST) in the Type Writing Test are called for the Computer Science Test. Each correctly typed word is awarded 0.125 marks; wrong spelling, substitution, repetition, or wrong punctuation counts as a mistake. The Computer Science Test cut-off is 50% for General/other category and 40% for SC/ST candidates. A 400-word English passage is dictated in 5 minutes and reproduced in shorthand/typescript within 10 minutes. Qualifying and cut-off criteria are the same as for Junior Typist. Candidates securing a minimum of 35% marks in each Part-I subject qualify for Part-II. The cut-off for Part-II (Practical) is 50% for General/other category and 40% for SC/ST candidates. The same cut-off applies for the Part-III Computer Practical Test. English: Essay writing, letter/application writing, translation of an Odia passage into English, translation of an English passage into Odia, and summary writing (allocation of marks differs slightly by post). Arithmetic: Vulgar fractions and decimals, H.C.F. and L.C.M., simple and compound interest, simple and compound practice, percentage, profit and loss, mixtures, partnership, averages, rates and taxes, insurance, square and cubic measures, and problems on time-and-work and time-and-distance. General Knowledge: Current events and everyday matters expected of an educated person. Computer Science Test (Practical): Paragraph formatting, table insertion, printing and saving files, file transfer, website browsing/downloading, e-mail use, pen-drive use, and basic accounting software. Viva-Voce: Assesses the candidate's alertness, general outlook, and suitability for the post.

Submit a separate application for each post, clearly mentioning the post name in capital letters (underlined) on top of the application form and envelope. Send the application by Speed Post to: Registrar, Civil Courts, Bhadrak, At- Nalanga, P.O- Barikpur Bazar, Dist- Bhadrak, Pin-756112 , so as to reach by 5:00 P.M. on or before 28.08.2026. faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Bhadrak District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of applications is 28th August 2026, by 5:00 P.M., either by Speed Post or through the Application Drop Box at the Registrar's office.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Bhadrak District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 34 vacancies have been notified across Junior Clerk-cum-Copyist (19), Stenographer Grade-III (5), Junior Typist (5), and Salaried Amin (5).

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee for Bhadrak District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no examination fee for candidates of any category.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for Bhadrak District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must be over 18 years and below 42 years of age as on 28.08.2026, with age relaxation applicable to reserved categories as per Government rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required for Junior Clerk-cum-Copyist?
faq.answer: A candidate must have passed a +3 examination or an equivalent qualification from a recognized university and hold a Diploma in Computer Application, along with an Odia language test equivalent to the M.E. Standard.

faq.question: Q6. Can a candidate apply for more than one post in this recruitment?
faq.answer: Yes, a candidate may apply for more than one post, but since the written examination for all posts is held on the same day, they can appear for only one post of their choice.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for Bhadrak District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection involves a Written Examination, a Computer Science/Skill Test, and a Viva-Voce Test, with post-specific qualifying cut-offs as detailed in the scheme of examination.

faq.question: Q8. Where should the application be sent?
faq.answer: Applications must be sent by Speed Post to the Registrar, Civil Courts, Bhadrak, At- Nalanga, P.O- Barikpur Bazar, Dist- Bhadrak, Pin-756112, or dropped in the Application Drop Box at the same office.
